description: On this week’s show: Saving birds from city lights, and helping astronauts inhabit robots First up, Science Contributing Correspondent Josh Sokol talks with host Sarah Crespi about the millions of migrating birds killed every year when they slam into buildings—attracted by brightly lit windows. New efforts are underway to predict bird migrations and dim lights along their path, using a bird-forecasting system called . Next, we hear from Aaron Pereira, a researcher at the German Aerospace Center…
classificationReason: Includes a substantial discussion of controlling an Earth-based robot from the International Space Station and astronaut immersion in rover control.
qualityReason: Features a researcher discussing a Science Robotics paper and technical human-robot interaction details.
